klasse.EIGEN: Masked by you and protection list

vorschau.erklaerung: Exactly this text is sent. Coloured items are replaced by a placeholder. Click a placeholder to reveal it; select a word to mask it.
vorschau.auswahlUngueltig: To mask, select 2 to 100 characters without placeholders.
vorschau.trefferPflicht: cannot be revealed (mandatory or protection list)
vorschau.keineTreffer: Nothing found: the text is sent unchanged.
vorschau.nichtAufdeckbar: Bank details, email addresses, phone numbers and terms on the protection list always stay masked.
vorschau.restOk: Final check passed: no bank details, email address or phone number in the text.
vorschau.restFehler: The text still contains: {{funde}}. Nothing will be sent like this. Mask the passage or use the local AI.
vorschau.netzFehler: The server cannot be reached. Nothing was sent.

hinweis.rest: Detection is rule-based and does not find everything. Paraphrases (“the hotel on Stephansplatz with 240 rooms”) and the content itself remain visible to the model. Use the local AI for confidential texts.
hinweis.deepl: The “Translate” step still sends the text to DeepL in plain text.
hinweis.lokal: The route to the local AI also runs through Cloudflare; the text leaves the building encrypted.

fehler.VORSCHAU_UNBEKANNT: This preview no longer exists. Please create a new one.
fehler.PFLICHT_UEBRIG: The text still contains bank details, an email address or a phone number. Nothing was sent.
fehler.PROXY_GESCHWAERZT: Redacted by the proxy: the egress filter replaced part of the text. The answer was discarded.
fehler.PLATZHALTER_UNBEKANNT: The model invented placeholders. The answer was discarded.
fehler.ERKENNUNG: The text cannot be pseudonymised safely. Nothing will be sent.
fehler.EINSTELLUNGEN: The protection rules cannot be read right now. Without them there is no preview.
fehler.NICHT_FREIGESCHALTET: This account is not enabled for the cloud AI.

verwaltung.hinweis: What is masked before text is sent to a cloud model. Bank details, email and phone are mandatory and cannot be switched off. The local AI always sees the plain text.
verwaltung.muster: Pattern of an item number without keyword (regular expression; empty means: only after “Art.-Nr.”, “Artikel”, “EAN”)
verwaltung.listeHinweis: Terms that are always masked, in any spelling: customers, projects, people.
verwaltung.probeHinweis: Paste a text and look at the preview. Nothing is sent to a model.
